The main takeaway from our work is that
cytotoxic drugs can sensitize malignant glioma cells, and possibly other tumour cells, to CD95 ligind-induced apoptosis.

chemotherapy can prime malignant glioma cells, and possibly other tumour cells, to respond to CD95 ligands, which may be used as a novel therapeutic strategy to treat malignant gliomas and other tumour types.
